title: T-GADE: Thermodynamical Generative-AI-Driven Evolution of LLM Artifacts
summary: Integrating evolutionary computation and large language models (LLMs) requires control of population diversity as well as generative capability. Among LLM outputs, those with explicit structure, such as a description paired with code, are structured artifacts; we use artifact for short. We propose T-GADE, which evolves these artifacts by extending thermodynamical genetic algorithms through LLM-based genetic operators and artifact-level diversity evaluation. A common free-energy objective supports generational and steady-state updates, with Fermi-type occupancy excluding repeated genotypes and Bose-type occupancy permitting them. We establish exact one-member removal and conditions for recovering the zero-temperature survival rule of Evolution of Heuristics (EoH). On the online bin-packing task studied in the EoH paper, excess measures relative bin-count overhead above a volume lower bound. Training excess uses search instances; transfer excess uses instances with another bin capacity. Generational Bose-type T-GADE at $T=0.003$ reduced median training excess by approximately 29%, from 1.152% to 0.815%, over 20 runs per configuration (two-sided Mann-Whitney $p=0.042$, Cliff's $δ=0.378$). Validation selection among its two highest-ranked final candidates reached the same median transfer excess as EoH, 0.496%. These results demonstrate the utility of thermodynamical selection and validation-based use of retained artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出T-GADE，将热力学遗传算法扩展至LLM结构化产物的进化，以自由能为目标统一世代与稳态更新，并在在线装箱任务上验证其多样性控制与性能优势。
AI.motivation: 融合进化计算与LLM不仅需要生成能力，还需对种群多样性进行控制；LLM输出的结构化产物（如描述配代码）为多样性度量与选择机制提供了新对象。
AI.method: T-GADE通过LLM遗传算子与产物级多样性评估扩展热力学遗传算法；采用统一自由能目标支持世代式与稳态更新，并引入Fermi型占据（排除重复基因型）与Bose型占据（允许多重重复）。理论上给出精确的单成员移除规则及恢复EoH零温生存规则的条件。
AI.result: 在EoH论文的在线装箱任务上，T=0.003的世代式Bose型T-GADE将训练超出量中位数由1.152%降至约0.815%（降低约29%），20次运行/配置，双尾Mann-Whitney p=0.042，Cliff's δ=0.378；在其排名最高的两个最终候选间做验证选择后，转移超出量中位数与EoH相同为0.496%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明热力学选择与对保留产物进行验证式使用具有实用价值，可在保持迁移性能的同时改善训练性能。

relevance.reason: 将热力学遗传算法与LLM生成算子结合，进化LLM产物以自动设计在线装箱启发式算法，直接命中LLM+EC+CO交叉及自动化启发式/算法设计。
relevance.title_zh: T-GADE：热力学生成式AI驱动的LLM产物进化

title: SAGE-Loop: Reliable Closed-Loop LLM-Driven AutoML with Trial-and-Correction and Adaptive Ensembling
summary: Automated machine learning (AutoML) is reshaping data-driven science and industrial practice, and as large language models are introduced into AutoML, pipeline reliability becomes as important as automation efficiency. However, existing AutoML still struggles to realize instant feedback and adaptive optimization during execution, so once a run drifts into a suboptimal or failed state, it lacks a process-level correction mechanism. The fundamental pathology lies in its one-way pipeline: intermediate failures are typically terminated or bypassed, while fixed paradigms often strengthen model generation but leave ensemble decisions static, weakening both execution reliability and the controlled use of structural diversity. This indicates that LLM-driven AutoML needs a closed-loop ability for trial-correction-improvement together with evidence-based use of model diversity. To this end, we propose SAGE-Loop, a reliable closed-loop, self-adaptive, LLM-driven AutoML framework that performs multi-round generation and validation for trial-and-repair, and adaptively selects ensemble strategies in both supervised and unsupervised tasks, thereby unifying how to generate with how to use models. Across 20 public datasets, SAGE-Loop consistently improves performance and stability on classification, regression, and clustering tasks. Additional results further show its ability to recover from execution failures and maintain robust pipeline behavior.

AI.tldr: SAGE-Loop：面向LLM驱动AutoML的可靠闭环自适应框架，通过多轮"试错-修复"生成与验证，并在监督/无监督任务中自适应选择集成策略，统一"如何生成模型"与"如何使用模型"，在20个公开数据集上提升分类、回归、聚类任务的性能与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的AutoML管道呈单向结构：中间失败通常被终止或绕过，缺乏执行期即时反馈与自适应优化；一旦运行进入次优或失败状态，缺少过程级纠错机制。同时固定范式偏重模型生成，集成决策保持静态，削弱了执行可靠性与结构多样性的可控利用。因此需要"试错-纠正-改进"的闭环能力，以及基于证据地利用模型多样性。
AI.method: 提出SAGE-Loop，一个可靠、闭环、自适应的LLM驱动AutoML框架：执行多轮生成与验证以实现试错与修复（trial-and-repair）；在监督与无监督任务中自适应选择集成策略，从而将模型生成与模型使用统一在同一闭环中。
AI.result: 在20个公开数据集上，SAGE-Loop在分类、回归与聚类任务中一致地提升了性能与稳定性；额外结果进一步表明其具备从执行失败中恢复的能力，并保持稳健的管道行为。
AI.conclusion: 闭环的试错-纠正-改进机制结合基于证据的多样性利用，可有效提升LLM驱动AutoML的执行可靠性与自适应优化能力，为数据驱动科学与工业实践中的自动化建模提供更稳健的范式。

relevance.reason: LLM驱动的闭环AutoML，通过试错-修正与自适应集成实现自动化模型设计，直接契合LLM用于自动化算法/流程优化的核心方向。
relevance.title_zh: SAGE-Loop：可靠闭环LLM驱动的AutoML与试错修正及自适应集成

title: Look Before You Leap: Pre-Action Verification for LLM Agents
summary: An LLM agent acts on the world by emitting actions: shell commands to run, edits to apply. A wrong action does not always fail loudly; it can fail silently, producing a plausible but incorrect effect that raises no error. We argue that a cheap deterministic check, run before an action takes effect, is an effective and underused form of agent oversight, and we study it across two action modalities in one framework. The idea is to fix an action's correct effect by construction, before any executor runs, so that silent failure is measured directly and the verifier may abstain rather than guess. For shell commands, a static verifier over 9930 commands and 482 tools catches 95.8% of invalid commands at a 10.0% false-positive rate. Its syntax and binary checks are oracle-exact, giving zero false positives while catching half of all errors; the flag check is bounded only by help-text coverage and accounts for every false positive. For code edits, a benchmark of 640 edits over 224 files isolating the apply step exposes a sharp split. Content-anchored formats such as search/replace and diff fail cleanly, whereas location-anchored formats fail silently: line numbers corrupt 99.1% of files under a one-line shift, and function-name edits hit the wrong function 12.7% of the time. In both settings a refuse-when-unsure policy turns silent failures into recoverable ones at a tunable cost in applicability: selective grounding reaches 0.958 recall at 7.0% false positives, and an anchor-and-verify applier records one silent misapplication in 8320 trials (0.01%). We release both benchmarks, the verifiers, and the guards.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在动作执行前运行廉价的确定性检查作为一种代理监督机制，在shell命令与代码编辑两种动作模态中验证其可行性与有效性，并发布相关基准、验证器与守卫。
AI.motivation: LLM代理通过发出动作（shell命令、代码编辑）作用于世界。错误动作并非总会明显失败，可能静默失败——产生看似合理但实际错误的效应而不报错，因此需要一种廉价、确定性的执行前检查作为监督手段。
AI.method: 在一个统一框架下研究两类动作模态。对shell命令，采用静态验证器（语法检查、二进制检查、标志检查），在9930条命令、482个工具上评测；对代码编辑，构建640个编辑、224个文件的基准以隔离apply步骤，对比内容锚定格式（search/replace、diff）与位置锚定格式（行号、函数名）的失败特征。核心思路是在任何执行器运行前，通过构造固定动作的正确效应，使静默失败可被直接测量，且验证器可选择弃权而非猜测。
AI.result: shell命令：静态验证器以10.0%假阳性率捕获95.8%的无效命令；语法与二进制检查为预言机精确，零假阳性并捕获一半错误；标志检查受限于帮助文本覆盖率，且是所有假阳性的来源。代码编辑：内容锚定格式干净失败，位置锚定格式静默失败——一行偏移下行号格式损坏99.1%的文件，函数名编辑12.7%概率命中错误函数。采用"不确定即拒绝"策略可将静默失败转为可恢复失败：选择性grounding达到0.958召回率、7.0%假阳性；锚定-验证applier在8320次试验中仅记录1次静默误用（0.01%）。
AI.conclusion: 动作执行前的廉价确定性检查是一种有效且未被充分利用的代理监督形式，能直接度量并缓解静默失败；两类模态下均验证了该思路，最终发布全部基准、验证器与守卫。

relevance.reason: 研究LLM智能体行动前的验证与安全监督，属于LLM智能体设计与控制的核心方向。
relevance.title_zh: 三思而后行：LLM智能体的行动前验证

title: EvoRS: On-Policy Self-Evolution of Reward Systems for Open-Ended Reinforcement Learning
summary: Open-ended reinforcement learning often relies on rubric-based rewards for tasks without directly verifiable answers. Yet the policy and reward system form a dynamic feedback loop: as the policy optimizes the current reward, an initially useful reward system may become unreliable due to reward hacking or reduced response discriminability. The reward system should therefore evolve rather than remain fixed during training. Existing dynamic-rubric methods adapt evaluation criteria, but reward failures can also arise from scoring mechanisms or signal composition. We introduce EvoRS, a self-evolving RL framework that evolves the reward system from on-policy experience, representing it as an executable Reward-DAG. Specifically, an agentic designer updates this system from on-policy rollouts and reward traces to maintain train-time reliability. Across writing and roleplay, EvoRS achieves the best quality under all three judges, outperforming the policy by \(2.107\) and \(4.767\) points, respectively, while reducing reward hacking and coverage failures and preserving reward informativeness. Ablations confirm that a comprehensive fixed reward system cannot remain reliable in open-ended tasks and must evolve throughout training.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoRS，一种将奖励系统表示为可执行 Reward-DAG 并随 on-policy 经验自我演化的强化学习框架，用于开放式任务，缓解奖励攻击与判别力下降。
AI.motivation: 开放式任务缺乏可直接验证的答案，常依赖基于评分标准（rubric）的奖励。然而策略与奖励系统构成动态反馈回路：策略优化当前奖励时，原本有效的奖励系统可能因奖励攻击或响应判别力下降而变得不可靠。现有动态 rubric 方法仅调整评价标准，未覆盖评分机制或信号组合导致的奖励失效问题，故奖励系统应随训练演化而非固定。
AI.method: EvoRS 是一种自演化 RL 框架，将奖励系统表示为可执行的 Reward-DAG；由智能体化设计器（agentic designer）依据 on-policy 回放轨迹与奖励轨迹更新该系统，以维持训练时的可靠性。
AI.result: 在写作与角色扮演任务上，EvoRS 在三位评判者下均取得最佳质量，分别较策略基线提升 2.107 和 4.767 分，同时降低奖励攻击与覆盖失败，并保持奖励信息量。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验证实，即便设计全面的固定奖励系统也无法在开放式任务中持续可靠，必须贯穿训练全程演化。

relevance.reason: 提出让奖励系统通过智能体在线自进化（Reward-DAG），属于LLM/RL中奖励与优化机制自动设计和进化，与自动化算法设计方向相关。
relevance.title_zh: EvoRS：面向开放式强化学习的奖励系统在线自进化

title: GenOR-Twin: A Semantic Middleware for Integrating Operational Discourse with Mathematical Optimization
summary: We introduce GenOR-Twin, a neuro-symbolic framework that bridges the translation gap between unstructured operational logs and rigorous mathematical optimization. Our architecture uniquely positions Large Language Models as semantic translators rather than direct solvers, ensuring that the system retains the feasibility guarantees of exact combinatorial methods. { \color{red}We design a dynamic constraint injection mechanism (the runtime translation of qualitative disruption events into formal mathematical constraints) that allows the system to structurally modify the optimization problem's feasibility region in real-time based on qualitative human inputs. The resulting bidirectional coupling---where operational observations update the virtual model state and optimized decisions are reflected back into the Knowledge Graph---satisfies the synchronization requirement of a proper Digital Twin. The framework features an adaptive decision policy} that automatically selects between low-complexity schedule repair and full re-optimization by analyzing the available system slack. Finally, we demonstrate the generalization of this approach across six distinct optimization domains, {\color{red}turning static models into resilient systems that adapt to the operational uncertainty and variability of real-world environments.}

AI.tldr: 提出GenOR-Twin神经符号框架，将大语言模型定位为语义翻译器而非直接求解器，通过动态约束注入与自适应决策策略实现数字孪生式的实时优化，并在六个优化领域验证其泛化性。
AI.motivation: 非结构化运行日志与严格数学优化之间存在翻译鸿沟，同时现实运行环境具有不确定性与多变性，静态优化模型难以适应；此外数字孪生要求操作观测与优化决策之间具备双向同步能力。
AI.method: 构建神经符号框架GenOR-Twin：以LLM作为语义翻译器，保留精确组合方法的可行性保证；设计动态约束注入机制，将定性扰动事件在运行时翻译为形式化数学约束，实时改变优化问题可行域；通过知识图谱实现操作观测更新虚拟模型状态、优化决策回写的双向耦合；并引入自适应决策策略，依据系统可用松弛量在低复杂度调度修复与完全重优化之间自动选择。
AI.result: 框架在六个不同优化领域展现出泛化能力，能够将静态模型转化为可适应现实环境运行不确定性与变异性的韧性系统。
AI.conclusion: 神经符号耦合方式可在保持精确求解可行性保证的前提下，使优化系统具备实时响应定性输入与运行扰动的能力，为构建真正意义上的数字孪生优化系统提供了可行路径。

relevance.reason: 将LLM作为语义翻译器连接自然语言运维日志与数学优化，并动态注入约束修改可行域，属于LLM+CO的核心交叉。
relevance.title_zh: GenOR-Twin：连接运维话语与数学优化的语义中间件

title: Signed Sensitivity of Expected Hitting Time to Mutation Rate in the (1+1) EA: Per-State Sign Theorems and Verifiable Certificates for Non-Lumpable Families
summary: For the (1+1) evolutionary algorithm with standard bit mutation, we study the sensitivity of the expected hitting time $H_p=\mathbb{E}_x T$ to the mutation rate. We first point out an easily overlooked formalization pitfall: the improvement event is not monotone in the mutation mask, so the unsigned (total-influence) form of the Margulis-Russo formula does not apply; the correct object is the signed endpoint difference. Second, we give an exact three-dimensional separation: two fitness functions share the entire one-step success-rate curve, yet their expected hitting times are two different exact rational numbers; hence one-step success-rate quantities do not determine the expected hitting time. Building on the runtime derivative $H'_p=(I-Q_p)^{-1}Q'_p H_p$, we construct computable double-residual sign certificates, prove a per-initial-state sign theorem on OneMax (for every non-optimal initial state, $\partial_c H<0$ on $0<c<1$, where $p=c/n$; at $c=1$ only the distance-one state is stationary), and extend the framework to non-lumpable positive linear families: an explicit non-lumpability witness, a block-interval double-residual certificate that covers all states without enumerating them, a uniform sign bound $\partial_c\mathbb{E}T\le -9n/16$ over the whole interval $c\in[1/4,1/2]$ for an explicit family at all even scales $n\ge 8$, and a heterogeneous instance certificate $H'_x\le -1/6$ on 57 of 63 states across $c=1$. All finite verifications use exact rational arithmetic. A bounded systematic literature search did not uncover this exact combination, although the underlying tools are well established; we therefore make no novelty claim beyond the stated combination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究(1+1) EA在标准位变异下期望命中时间对变异率的敏感性：指出改进事件非单调导致Margulis-Russo公式不适用，给出精确三维分离、符号证书与OneMax上的逐初始状态符号定理，并扩展到非可集中正线性族。
AI.motivation: 标准(1+1) EA的命中时间$H_p$对变异率的敏感性缺乏严格刻画。既有工具多针对单调事件，而改进事件在变异掩码上非单调，直接套用Margulis-Russo型公式存在形式化陷阱；同时需要判断单步成功率是否足以决定期望命中时间。
AI.method: 先给出精确三维分离构造：两个适应度函数共享完整单步成功率曲线但期望命中时间为不同有理数。基于runtime导数$H'_p=(I-Q_p)^{-1}Q'_p H_p$构造可计算的双残差符号证书；在OneMax上证明逐初始状态符号定理；将框架推广到非可集中正线性族，给出非可集中性见证、块区间双残差证书、$c\in[1/4,1/2]$上的统一符号界及异质实例证书。所有有限验证使用精确有理算术。
AI.result: 证明改进事件非单调，故无符号(total-influence)形式Margulis-Russo不适用，正确对象为带符号端点差；构造两个适应度函数共享单步成功率曲线但期望命中时间为两个不同的精确有理数；在OneMax上对每个非最优初始状态证明$0<c<1$时$\partial_c H<0$，$c=1$时仅距离一状态为驻点；对显式非可集中正线性族在$n\ge 8$偶数尺度上得到$c\in[1/4,1/2]$统一界$\partial_c\mathbb{E}T\le -9n/16$，并给出覆盖63态中57态的异质实例证书$H'_x\le -1/6$。
AI.conclusion: 单步成功率量不能决定期望命中时间；期望命中时间的变异率敏感性需用带符号端点差与双残差证书刻画。所提框架在OneMax及非可集中正线性族上给出可验证的负导数符号结论，且不主张超出该组合的新颖性。

relevance.reason: 研究(1+1)EA变异率对期望命中时间的敏感性，属于演化计算的理论分析，与EC核心方向强相关。
relevance.title_zh: (1+1)EA中期望命中时间对变异率的有符号敏感性：逐状态符号定理与非可分族可验证证书

title: GTA: Graph Theory Agent and Benchmark for Algorithmic Graph Reasoning with LLMs
comment: 49 pages, 11 figures, including references and appendix
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly asked to reason over structured data such as graphs, yet how reliably they can carry out multi-step graph algorithms in language remains unclear. Existing evaluations tend to use simple tasks on small graphs, to score code generation rather than reasoning over the graph itself, or to fix a single input format. We introduce Graph Theory Bench (GT Bench), a benchmark covering 24 classical graph problems in 44 task-structure settings, with over 100,000 examples across four representations: natural language, structured language, adjacency list, and adjacency matrix. Evaluating eight LLMs on GT Bench shows that accuracy is strongly tied to the input representation, that the best representation shifts with graph density, size, and topology as well as with the model, and that this sensitivity persists, attenuated, in the strongest reasoning models. Building on these observations, we propose the Graph Theory Agent (GTA), which pairs a preference-trained representation selector with plan-and-decompose scaffolding around a frozen executor LLM. GTA lifts Phi-4 from 53.5% to 69.1% on the benchmark's easy split and from 33.0% to 41.5% on its hard split, outperforming eight prompting and agent baselines, and transfers without retraining to GraCoRe and NLGraph. Code for benchmark generation and evaluation: https://github.com/xzx34/GTA. The project homepage is available at https://xzx34.github.io/gta/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GT Bench基准与Graph Theory Agent (GTA)框架，系统评估LLM在图结构数据上的多步推理能力，并通过表示选择与分解式规划显著提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM图推理评估存在三大局限：任务简单、图规模小；评分侧重代码生成而非图本身的推理；固定单一输入格式。因此无法明确LLM能否可靠地用自然语言执行多步图算法。
AI.method: 1) 构建GT Bench：覆盖24类经典图问题、44种任务-结构设置、超10万样本，含自然语言、结构化语言、邻接表、邻接矩阵四种表示。2) 对8个LLM进行评测，分析表示、图密度、规模、拓扑与模型间的敏感性。3) 提出GTA：偏好训练的表示选择器 + plan-and-decompose脚手架 + 冻结的执行器LLM。
AI.result: 准确率与输入表示强相关；最优表示随图密度、规模、拓扑及模型变化；该敏感性在最强推理模型中依然存在但有所减弱。GTA将Phi-4在easy split上从53.5%提升至69.1%，hard split上从33.0%提升至41.5%，优于8个提示与智能体基线，并可无重训练迁移至GraCoRe与NLGraph。
AI.conclusion: LLM图算法推理对输入表示高度敏感，表示选择是提升性能的关键因素；结合表示选择与规划分解的GTA能有效且可迁移地增强冻结LLM的图推理能力。

title: ParaRecover: A Process-Level Benchmark for Error Localization and Recovery in Parallel Tool-Use Agents
summary: Existing agent benchmarks mainly evaluate final task success or tool-call correctness, providing limited insight into whether agents can reliably diagnose and recover from intermediate execution failures. This limitation becomes particularly critical in multi-turn parallel tool-use scenarios, where errors may propagate across dependent branches and trigger cascading failures. We introduce ParaRecover, a process-level benchmark for evaluating error localization and recovery in multi-turn parallel tool-use agents. Built upon a fine-grained taxonomy of 14 error types covering planning dependencies, tool selection, and argument matching, the benchmark comprises 10,626 instances spanning two difficulty levels. To enable finegrained, process-oriented evaluation, we further propose the SDE rubric, which measures structural integrity, diagnostic reasoning, and evolutionary strategy during agent execution.Experiments across more than ten mainstream LLMs reveal that even state-of-the-art models still struggle with multi-turn error propagation,implicit tool-use failures, and precise replanning. Moreover, we demonstrate that the SDE rubric provides effective supervision signals for improving agents' reflective recovery capabilities. Our data and code are available at https://github.com/gbw206/ParaRecover.

AI.tldr: 提出ParaRecover过程级基准，评估多轮并行工具调用智能体的中间错误定位与恢复能力，含14类错误分类、10626个实例及SDE评价量规。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准主要评估最终任务成功或工具调用正确性，难以揭示智能体能否可靠地诊断并从中间执行失败中恢复；在多轮并行工具使用场景中，错误会跨依赖分支传播并引发级联失败，该问题尤为关键。
AI.method: 构建基于14种错误类型（覆盖规划依赖、工具选择、参数匹配）细粒度分类的ParaRecover基准，包含两个难度级别的10626个实例；并提出SDE量规，从结构完整性、诊断推理、演化策略三个维度进行面向过程的细粒度评估。
AI.result: 在十余个主流大语言模型上的实验表明，即使最先进模型在多轮错误传播、隐式工具使用失败和精确重规划方面仍表现不佳；SDE量规还能为提升智能体反思性恢复能力提供有效的监督信号。
AI.conclusion: ParaRecover将智能体评估从结果导向推进到过程导向，为多轮并行工具使用中的错误定位、恢复诊断与反思能力提升提供了细粒度基准与监督手段，数据和代码已开源。

title: Granularity-Adaptive Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning is now the standard way to train large language model agents on long-horizon tasks, where dozens of interdependent actions precede a single sparse reward. Critic-free, group-relative methods such as GRPO suit this regime, but they broadcast one trajectory-level scalar to every step and cannot say which decision drove the outcome. GiGPO recovers a step-level signal by grouping time steps that share an anchor state, yet it merges the step- and episode-level estimates under one fixed weight, spending the same resolution on a pivotal branching decision as on a routine, near-deterministic transition. We argue that the right resolution is state-dependent, and propose GACA, a critic-free estimator whose granularity follows an uncertainty-based criticality proxy. GACA scores every step by the negative log-likelihood its own rollout already records, then blends the two advantages with a per-step weight that grows with that score, so the gradient places more weight on the fine-grained signal at above-average NLL and on the episode-level signal below it. We derive an exact risk decomposition for the implemented mixture and show that sufficiently small modulation improves on fixed mixing under positive directional alignment. A separate conditional result bounds local action-value variation using expected NLL, while an error-projection analysis characterizes when mixing adds value beyond scalar uncertainty reweighting. On ALFWorld and WebShop, GACA improves task success over GRPO and GiGPO at both 1.5B and 7B scales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GACA，一种无评论家（critic-free）的强化学习优势估计器，其信号粒度随状态不确定性自适应变化，在ALFWorld与WebShop上超越GRPO和GiGPO。
AI.motivation: 长时域任务中奖励稀疏，GRPO等组相对方法只把轨迹级标量广播到每步，无法指出哪一步决策决定结果；GiGPO虽通过锚定状态分组恢复步级信号，却以固定权重融合步级与回合级估计，对关键分支决策与近乎确定性的常规转移投入相同分辨率。作者主张正确的分辨率应是状态依赖的。
AI.method: 提出GACA：以每步自身rollout已记录的负对数似然（NLL）作为不确定性关键性代理进行打分，并用随该分数增长的逐步权重融合步级与回合级优势——NLL高于均值时加大细粒度信号权重，低于均值时偏向回合级信号。理论上给出所实现混合的精确风险分解，证明在正向方向对齐下足够小的调制优于固定混合；并用条件性结果以期望NLL界定局部动作价值变化，用误差投影分析刻画混合何时比标量不确定性重加权更有价值。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上，GACA在1.5B与7B两种规模下均提升了任务成功率，优于GRPO与GiGPO。
AI.conclusion: GACA表明优势估计的信号粒度应依据状态不确定性自适应调整，通过基于NLL的逐步权重调制兼顾关键步骤的细粒度信号与常规步骤的回合级信号，并具备理论保障与实证收益。

title: Competence-Gated Pooling of Language Models and Priors for Event Forecasting
summary: In hybrid forecasting, a language model is often one of several available signals. A system may already have a market, crowd, or statistical forecast and must decide whether the model adds useful information or should be ignored. The relevant target is therefore not standalone model accuracy, but relative competence, defined as the model's marginal value beyond the available external forecast. Under Brier loss, we characterize when model disagreement can improve an external forecast and derive the gain from using domain-specific rather than global pooling weights. We then introduce a competence gate that estimates domain-level source weights from resolved outcomes, shrinks uncertain estimates toward a global weight, and recalibrates the pooled forecast. Across 2,357 resolved binary questions and five language models, the gate improves the main external baseline from 0.0771 to 0.0732 Brier and significantly outperforms global forecast combinations. The gain remains significant under leakage controls and against a leakage-safe time-series prior on the pooled structured set, with separate evidence on FRED. In contrast, the gate gives no significant improvement on the official ForecastBench market subset, where it largely defers to the market. Across four Qwen models, verbal confidence does not reliably identify when the model outperforms the external forecast, while outcome-estimated competence supports better abstention decisions. These results provide a practical approach for selective model use based on measured marginal value.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究混合预测中语言模型相对外部预测的"边际价值"，提出基于结果的"能力门控"机制，通过域级权重估计、向全局权重收缩与再校准，在2,357个二元问题上将Brier分数从0.0771改善至0.0732，且显著优于全局组合，但在官方市场子集上无明显改进。
AI.motivation: 在混合预测场景中，语言模型通常只是可用的若干信号之一，系统往往已拥有市场、群体或统计预测。因此真正需要判断的不是模型的独立准确率，而是模型在已有外部预测之上是否带来额外的边际信息，即"相对能力"。在此设定下，需要明确模型分歧何时能改进外部预测，以及如何决定是否采纳模型输出。
AI.method: 在Brier损失下刻画模型分歧改进外部预测的条件，并推导使用域特定池化权重（而非全局池化权重）所能获得的增益。据此提出"能力门控"（competence gate）：从已揭晓的结果中估计域级信号源权重，将不确定估计向全局权重收缩，并对池化后的预测进行再校准。
AI.result: 在2,357个已揭晓的二元问题与五个语言模型上，门控将主要外部基线从0.0771 Brier改善至0.0732，并显著优于全局预测组合。该增益在泄漏控制下、以及在池化结构化集合上与泄漏安全的时间序列先验对比中仍保持显著，并在FRED上获得独立证据。相反，在官方ForecastBench市场子集上门控未带来显著改进，主要让位于市场。对四个Qwen模型，语言化置信度无法可靠识别模型何时优于外部预测，而基于结果估计的能力则支持更好的弃权决策。
AI.conclusion: 应以测得的边际价值而非独立准确率来指导语言模型的选择性使用。能力门控提供了一种实用方法，在模型确有增量价值时采纳其输出，在无增量价值时（如市场子集）则让位于外部预测；同时表明语言化置信度不足以替代基于结果的能力估计。

title: Local Edits, Global Ripples: Replay-Informed Policy Adaptation for Workflow Synthesis
summary:
Prompt-policy editing offers a practical way to improve agents that synthesize executable workflows without updating the underlying model. However, persistent prompt editing has two coupled properties. First, edit locality does not imply effect locality: an edit confined to one policy segment can ripple through downstream execution, altering behavior beyond the edited segment. Second, edit effects are composition-sensitive: edits that work in isolation can interfere after composition, causing one or both to lose their benefit or become harmful. Persistent adaptation must therefore support two distinct decisions: identifying where the policy should change from execution feedback, and determining whether the resulting edit remains safe to persist after composition.
  To address these challenges, we introduce RIPPLE (Replay-Informed Persistent Policy Localization and Editing), which separates where an edit is made from whether it remains safe after composition. It diagnoses failed trajectories, maps each actionable failure to a predefined policy segment, and restricts the correction to that part of the policy. RIPPLE then evaluates candidates against the same iteration-start policy to compare their isolated gains, before replaying promising edits after previously accepted updates to expose downstream effects and interactions. Only edits that remain safe under composition are retained.
  We evaluate RIPPLE on Flow-HO, a synthetic held-out benchmark for executable workflow synthesis. RIPPLE improves validation success by up to 23.1% and yields positive gains on two additional frozen language-model backbones, while maintaining edit efficiency and low execution cost. Targeted interaction analysis further demonstrates both properties: a segment-local tool-use edit changes downstream resource resolution and validation, while an edit beneficial in isolation becomes harmful after composition.

AI.tldr: 提出 RIPPLE 方法，将提示策略编辑中"何处改"与"改后是否可安全持久化"解耦，通过重放评估组合安全性，在可执行工作流合成任务上提升验证成功率最高 23.1%。
AI.motivation: 无需更新底层模型即可改进智能体，提示策略编辑是一种实用手段，但持久化提示编辑存在两个耦合特性：一是编辑局部性不等于效果局部性，限于某策略片段的编辑会波及下游执行；二是编辑效果对组合敏感，单独有效的编辑在组合后可能相互干扰、失效甚至有害。因此持久化自适应需同时解决两个问题：从执行反馈中定位策略应改之处，以及判断编辑在组合后是否仍值得持久保留。
AI.method: RIPPLE 将"在哪编辑"与"组合后是否安全"分离。首先诊断失败轨迹，将可操作的失败映射到预定义策略片段，把修正限制在该片段内；随后以同一迭代起始策略为基准评估候选编辑，比较其孤立增益；再将有潜力的编辑在已被接受的更新之后重放，以暴露下游效应与交互；仅保留在组合下仍安全的编辑。
AI.result: 在合成留出基准 Flow-HO 上评估，验证成功率最多提升 23.1%，并在另外两个冻结语言模型骨干上取得正向增益，同时保持编辑效率与较低执行成本。交互分析进一步验证了上述两个特性：片段局部性的工具使用编辑会改变下游资源解析与验证；而单独有益的编辑在组合后变得有害。
AI.conclusion: 持久化提示策略编辑必须显式区分编辑定位与组合安全性；RIPPLE 通过"定位—孤立评估—组合重放验证"的流程，在可执行工作流合成任务上实现稳定增益，且不依赖模型更新，具备跨骨干的可迁移性。

title: Differential Privacy Meets Fixed Parameter Tractability: Algorithms and Lower Bounds
summary:
We study combinatorial optimization problems under the constraint of $ε$-differential privacy ($ε$-DP). Given the strong lower bounds for explicitly outputting solutions, we work within the implicit representation framework of Gupta et al. (SODA 2010), where a private polynomial-time randomized "encoder" generates a representation of a solution, and a "decoder" uses this representation along with the input to extract a valid final solution.
  In this work, we generalize this framework by allowing the encoder to run in fixed-parameter tractable time. This circumvents approximation barriers inherent to polynomial-time algorithms and obtains improved guarantees for many fundamental combinatorial optimization problems.
  Finally, we establish the first representation-independent lower bounds for our framework. Assuming a non-uniform variant of the Gap Exponential Time Hypothesis, for sufficiently small $ε> 0$, we prove that no $ε$-DP encoder-decoder pair can achieve certain approximation guarantees, if the decoder runs in subexponential time. We further provide representation-dependent lower bounds that hold even for larger $ε$.

AI.tldr: 本文将隐式表示框架中编码器放宽为固定参数可处理(FPT)时间，在ε-差分隐私下为多个组合优化问题取得更优保证，并首次给出与表示无关的下界。
AI.motivation: ε-DP下显式输出解的强下界限制了算法表现，需绕开多项式时间算法的近似障碍，同时填补该框架缺乏表示无关下界的空白。
AI.method: 在Gupta等(SODA 2010)的隐式表示框架(私有编码器生成表示、解码器结合输入输出可行解)基础上，允许编码器运行固定参数可处理(FPT)时间；并基于非均匀Gap-ETH建立下界。
AI.result: 对多个基础组合优化问题获得改进的近似保证；在充分小ε下，若解码器亚指数时间，则不存在ε-DP编码-解码对达到特定近似保证；并提供对更大ε仍成立的表示相关下界。
AI.conclusion: 扩展隐式表示为FPT编码器可规避多项式时间近似障碍，同时给出首个表示无关下界，刻画了ε-DP组合优化的内在极限。

title: Repair Before Reinforce: Context-Augmented Knowledge Graph Reasoning for Multi-Hop Question Answering
summary: Question-answering often requires reasoning across multiple connected facts rather than retrieving a single isolated relation. Knowledge graphs (KGs) provide a structured way to represent such facts, but training large language models (LLMs) only on isolated KG head-relation-tail triples may limit their ability to learn the surrounding context needed for multi-hop reasoning. In this work, we propose a context-augmented training framework for multi-hop question-answering. Although generally applicable, we validate the framework in the context of disease-specific KGs, extracted using a reliable KG extraction framework called GraphMERT, for Gastroparesis and Diabetes. For each primary KG triple, we attach supporting triples extracted from the same source text chunk to form a context graph (CG). This creates two supervision settings: KG-grounded supervision, which uses only the target KG triple or path, and CG-grounded supervision, which uses the target KG triple or path together with supporting context triples. We train the Qwen3-14B model using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) under both settings, producing KGModel and CGModel variants. To strengthen the lower-hop factual foundation of the models, we introduce an LLM-judged, history-aware adaptive repair pipeline that identifies unresolved one-hop failures, continually fine-tunes on targeted repair examples, and removes or quarantines problematic noisy triples. This repair stage enables the models to reach 100% accuracy on the cleaned retained one-hop validation sets. Finally, we employ reinforcement learning (RL) using lower-hop question-answer items and evaluate generalization on harder 3-hop, 4-hop, and 5-hop tasks. Across both diseases, context-augmented supervision consistently improves multi-hop performance over KG-only supervision. RL initialized from repaired SFT checkpoints yields larger and more stable gains.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文增强的多跳问答训练框架，在疾病知识图谱上用KG-grounded与CG-grounded两种监督对比，配合自适应修复与强化学习，验证上下文监督能稳定提升多跳推理性能。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答需要在多个关联事实间推理，而非检索单一关系。知识图谱虽能结构化表示事实，但仅用孤立的头-关系-尾三元组训练LLM，会限制模型学习多跳推理所需的上下文信息。
AI.method: 基于GraphMERT为胃轻瘫与糖尿病构建疾病知识图谱；为每个主KG三元组附加来自同一源文本块的支撑三元组，构成上下文图（CG），形成KG-grounded（仅目标三元组/路径）与CG-grounded（目标加支撑上下文）两种监督设置。用SFT训练Qwen3-14B得到KGModel与CGModel；引入LLM评判的、历史感知的自适应修复流水线，识别未解决的单跳失败，持续在针对性修复样本上微调并剔除或隔离噪声三元组；最后用低跳问答项做RL，并在3/4/5跳任务上评估泛化。

AI.conclusion: 上下文增强监督相比孤立三元组监督能显著提升多跳推理；低跳事实基础的修复与RL结合可带来更大、更稳定的性能增益，框架具有通用性，在疾病知识图谱场景中得到验证。

title: Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling: A Diversity-Preserving Approach to LLM Decoding
comment: Accepted at the COLM 2026 Workshop on Efficient Reasoning
summary: Inference-time power sampling via Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) can substantially improve large language model (LLM) reasoning without requiring post-training. However, many existing SMC approaches rely on equal-weight resampling, which can aggressively prune low-weight trajectories, discarding potentially correct reasoning paths and degrading the genealogical diversity of the search space. To address this, we introduce Chopthin-Consensus Power Sampling (CCPS). Our method applies the Chopthin resampler to LLM decoding: rather than equalizing weights and forcing unnecessary particle duplication, it enforces an upper bound on the ratio between the largest and smallest weights and carries the unequal weights forward. This targeted intervention preserves a richer set of distinct reasoning paths, keeps the weighted SMC approximation unchanged in conditional expectation, and guarantees a lower bound on the post-resampling effective sample size (ESS). To fully exploit this enriched population, we employ a semantic-majority selection mechanism that merges token-identical final trajectories, clusters semantically equivalent answers, and returns the answer supported by the largest number of distinct trajectories. Evaluating across three open-weight models and five reasoning benchmarks, we show that Chopthin increases oracle coverage in 13 of 15 settings. Combined with semantic-majority selection, CCPS matches or exceeds the final-answer accuracy of the Power-SMC baseline in 14 of 15 settings, delivering absolute gains of up to 10.6 percentage points. These findings demonstrate that diversity-preserving resampling and diversity-aware selection are complementary mechanisms for training-free LLM reasoning. Code is available at github.com/MinooAhmadii/chopthin-consensus-power-sampling.

title: Certified Safety Curation: Distribution-Free Guarantees for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: Safe offline reinforcement learning assumes a cost function on every transition. We ask what remains possible when safety can be judged only by comparing short clips and occasionally asking whether an episode exceeded its budget. Certified safety curation answers with a filter-then-clone pipeline: a state-only value trained from segment comparisons scores whole trajectories, Learn-then-Test calibration certifies a selection threshold under a distribution-free $(α, δ)$ bound on the unsafe fraction of the selection, and behavior cloning follows. We are not aware of prior work certifying the composition of a training set for offline RL or imitation. Oracle controls justify the design: reweighting individual transitions fails even with an exact value, so the value selects whole trajectories. The policies satisfy the cost budget on eleven of fifteen DSRL tasks, one short of cloning the ground-truth safe subset, which needs a label on every trajectory; the uncertified variant reaches twelve. Retrained on the certified selection, the strongest full-label method becomes safe where no setting of its own cost target rescues it. Refusal is predictable: the certificate's probability has a closed form in the purity the pool attains, which the calibration sample estimates and the scorer enters only through.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究在仅有片段比较与偶发预算反馈的弱监督条件下，如何为离线强化学习筛选并认证安全训练集，提出"过滤-克隆"流水线（Certified Safety Curation）。
AI.motivation: 传统安全离线强化学习假设每个转移都有可用的代价函数，但现实中安全往往只能通过比较短片段、偶尔得知回合是否超预算来判断，作者因此追问在这种弱监督下安全筛选是否仍然可行。
AI.method: 采用滤波-克隆流水线：用仅基于状态的、由片段比较训练得到的价值函数给整条轨迹打分；再用Learn-then-Test校准在无分布假设的(α, δ)界下认证选择阈值；最后进行行为克隆。作者指出该工作首次对离线RL/模仿学习的训练集组成进行认证，并用oracle对照实验验证"按轨迹而非按转移选择"的设计必要性。
AI.result: 在15个DSRL任务中有11个满足代价预算，仅比用全标签克隆真实安全子集少一个任务；未认证变体达到12个。用认证选择重训后，最强的全标签方法在其自身代价目标任何设置下都失效，却在认证集合上变安全；拒绝行为可预测，证书概率对池纯度有闭式表达，由校准样本估计并仅通过打分器进入。
AI.conclusion: 在只有片段比较和偶发预算信号的弱监督下，通过过滤-克隆与分布无关认证，仍能构造具有安全保证的离线训练集，且按轨迹选择是必要的；认证机制的可预测性为方法提供了理论支撑。

title: Inverting Self-Triggered Control: Adversarial Reinforcement Learning for Sparse Denial-of-Service Attacks
summary: Self-triggered reinforcement learning control (RL-STC) learns the sparsest control schedule that preserves Lyapunov-decreasing stability under a Run-Time Assurance (RTA) override. We invert this: an adversarial RL agent learns the sparsest jamming or Denial-of-Service (DoS) schedule that destabilizes the closed loop, with a Lyapunov-increase admissibility predicate mirroring the defender's safety certificate. We prove a plant-property lower bound on the minimum jam count required for an immediate hold-last medium-access-control adversary to force a crash against a self-triggered controller (STC) satisfying a Lyapunov contract, and recover a certificate-level analog of the consecutive-grouping optimality of prior count-budget DoS scheduling as a corollary. This extends the DoS-scheduling count-budget analysis from periodic and linear-time-invariant to STC controllers. Empirically, we train against four fixed defenders per plant (one Linear Quadratic Regulator (LQR) and three RL-STC) on Pendulum, CartPole, and Quadrotor2D. The learned adversary is the only adversary that crashes every defender on every plant at $100\%$: greedy misses Quadrotor2D LQR on $42\%$ of episodes and periodic misses Pendulum LQR on $97\%$. On jam-time-per-failure it beats baselines by up to $2.8\times$, and shows its widest absolute margin on Quadrotor2D LQR. Robustness ablations show that Gaussian observation noise exceeding the initial-state magnitude and position-only observation both preserve $100\%$ failure rate and keep the learned adversary strictly ahead of both baselines on jam-time-per-failure.

AI.tldr: 本文将自触发强化学习控制（RL-STC）反向建模为对抗问题：由对抗RL智能体学习最稀疏的干扰/DoS调度以破坏闭环稳定性，并给出击溃STC所需最小干扰次数的下界与相应最优性推论，实验证明所学对抗策略在多个对象与防御器上均达100%失效率并显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 既有DoS调度计数预算分析主要针对周期控制器与线性时不变系统，缺乏对自触发控制（STC）这类事件驱动、基于Lyapunov契约的稀疏控制调度的对抗脆弱性刻画。作者希望把防御侧的最稀疏控制调度问题对称地转化为攻击侧的最稀疏DoS调度问题，以刻画在RTA安全覆盖下STC仍可被破坏的条件和代价下限。
AI.method: 构造对抗RL智能体，学习最稀疏的干扰或DoS调度使闭环失稳，采用与防御方安全证书相对的Lyapunov增长型可采纳性谓词；针对满足Lyapunov契约的STC，证明迫使立即采用hold-last的MAC对手造成崩溃所需最小干扰次数的系统属性下界，并推论得到计数预算DoS调度中“连续分组”最优性的证书级类比。实验在Pendulum、CartPole、Quadrotor2D上对每对象四个固定防御器（一个LQR、三个RL-STC）训练对抗策略，并与贪心、周期基线对比，评估失效率与每次失效所需干扰时间，并做高斯观测噪声与仅位置观测的鲁棒性消融。
AI.result: 所学对抗策略是唯一在全部对象、全部防御器上均实现100%崩溃的对手：贪心在Quadrotor2D LQR上42%回合失效，周期在Pendulum LQR上97%回合失效。在每次失效所需干扰时间上比基线最高优2.8倍，绝对差距在Quadrotor2D LQR上最大。鲁棒性消融表明，当高斯观测噪声幅度超过初始状态量级、以及仅使用位置观测时，仍保持100%失效率，并在干扰时间-失效指标上稳定领先两个基线。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将DoS调度的计数预算分析从周期与线性时不变控制扩展到自触发控制，建立了基于植物属性与Lyapunov证书的攻击代价下界及最优性推论，并在多对象多防御器的经验结果中验证了学习型稀疏DoS调度对STC的强破坏性与鲁棒性。

title: Learning Symbolic Constraint Representations from Examples: A Neuro-Symbolic Approach
summary: Learning user-defined concepts as constraint networks has been extensively studied in the constraint acquisition (CA) literature. However, existing approaches typically rely on intensive interactions with a human oracle, making the learning process costly in terms of time and number of queries. In this paper, we propose a neuro-symbolic framework for automatic CA that significantly reduces user involvement by introducing neural Oracle Transformer models which learn to emulate user responses and to generalize conceptual knowledge. Trained on previously available examples, the learned oracle interacts with a dedicated CA engine, FastCA, which systematically refines the oracle's responses into a sound, consistent, and interpretable constraint network. This neuro-symbolic interaction enables the recovery of structured symbolic models from data without prior domain knowledge. Our results demonstrate that this neuro-symbolic interplay effectively aligns data-driven pattern recognition with symbolic reasoning, offering a robust approach to automating model construction in combinatorial domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个神经符号框架用于自动约束获取（CA），通过神经Oracle Transformer模型模拟用户响应并泛化概念知识，减少对人类oracle的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有约束获取方法通常依赖与人类oracle的大量交互，导致学习过程在时间和查询数量上成本高昂。
AI.method: 引入神经Oracle Transformer模型来模拟用户响应并泛化概念知识；将训练好的oracle与专用CA引擎FastCA交互，系统地将oracle的响应精炼为可靠、一致且可解释的约束网络。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，这种神经符号交互能有效将数据驱动的模式识别与符号推理结合，在无需先验领域知识的情况下从数据中恢复结构化符号模型。
AI.conclusion: 该神经符号框架为组合领域中的模型构建自动化提供了一种稳健方法，能显著减少用户参与并自动化CA过程。

title: AMDKernelVault: Large-Scale Datasets and Agentic Training for AMD GPU Kernel Optimization
comment: N pages, 3 figures, including appendix. First four authors contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/AMD-AGI/hip_kernel_llm_lab Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/amd/AIG-Datasets
summary: We introduce AMDKernelVault, an open HIP and Triton kernel corpus and training framework for recent AMD CDNA GPUs. Existing LLM-based kernel agents are largely CUDA/NVIDIA-centric and often depend on repeated frontier-LLM calls for generation, reflection, and optimization. To address this gap, we develop HIPKernelGen and TritonKernelGen, agent-driven pipelines that transform PyTorch references into HIP or Triton kernels, compile and validate candidates under ROCm, and latency-profile them on AMD hardware. The corpus contains 62,153 execution-verified HIP kernel samples, 2,377 production-grounded ROCm Libraries QA entries, and 39,893 Triton kernels. We further train Qwen3-8B with supervised fine-tuning and execution-aware reinforcement learning as a demonstration of the corpus's utility. Under fixed evaluation budgets, it achieves the highest correctness among the compared models on PyTorch-to-HIP (34.0% Pass@1), TritonBench-G (33.2% Corr@3), and ROCmBench (41.94% Corr@3), but does not uniformly lead compilation or speed metrics. The corpus and documentation are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/amd/AIG-Datasets, and the associated training and kernel-generation code is available at https://github.com/AMD-AGI/hip_kernel_llm_lab.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AMDKernelVault，一个面向 AMD CDNA GPU 的开源 HIP/Triton 内核语料库与训练框架，并配套智能体驱动的内核生成流程，演示了在该语料上训练的模型在多项内核任务上的正确率表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的内核智能体大多以 CUDA/NVIDIA 为中心，且依赖反复调用前沿 LLM 进行生成、反思与优化，缺乏面向 AMD 生态的开放语料与训练框架。为填补这一空白，作者构建了 AMD 平台的内核语料库与生成流水线。
AI.method: 开发 HIPKernelGen 与 TritonKernelGen 两条智能体驱动流水线，将 PyTorch 参考实现转换为 HIP 或 Triton 内核，在 ROCm 下编译验证，并在 AMD 硬件上进行延迟性能分析。构建的语料库包含 62,153 条经执行验证的 HIP 内核样本、2,377 条基于生产环境的 ROCm Libraries QA 条目以及 39,893 个 Triton 内核。随后使用监督微调与执行感知强化学习训练 Qwen3-8B 以验证语料库效用。

AI.conclusion: AMDKernelVault 为 AMD CDNA GPU 提供了开放的内核语料库、生成流水线与训练代码，验证了执行感知训练对内核生成正确率的提升作用，为 AMD 生态的 LLM 内核智能体研究提供了数据与基线支持。

title: Niching Agents in The Core
summary: The Core is a unique competitive co-evolution algorithm that allows agents to evolve autonomous control without utilizing a traditional fitness function. The agents evolve via local interactions through tournament selection, crossover, and mutation, producing offspring by evolving better controllers. Previous works have shown The Core's ability to evolve agents capable of combat and navigation in the Xpilot video game. This research expands upon that premise by niching agents to specific subsets of the original environment The Core was tested in. Our results demonstrate the niched agents capacity for success over agents niched to the entire system and agents niched to different sub-environments.

AI.method: 采用The Core竞争性协同进化算法，智能体通过局部交互、锦标赛选择、交叉与变异产生后代以进化更优控制器；将智能体生态位化到原测试环境的特定子集，并与其他生态位设置进行对比。

title: Decentralized Evolution of Hexapod Gaits with Independent Leg Controllers
summary: This paper presents a novel approach to hexapod locomotion by evolving each leg's gait independently through a decentralized evolutionary algorithm. Using the Webots simulator and the Mantis hexapod robot, we optimize individual leg controllers without centralized coordination, allowing emergent behaviors to drive the development of efficient, coordinated locomotion. Our decentralized method is benchmarked against cooperative coevolution, demonstrating improved efficacy in generating stable and adaptive gaits while showing interesting emergent coordination. By enabling independent evolution of leg controllers, this method reduces the complexity of gait optimization and highlights the potential of decentralized strategies for scalable and adaptive robotic systems.

title: VRL-Bench: Benchmarking agents on computer control tasks under finite trial budgets
summary: Learning from trial and error is a promising way to improve language agents on complex tasks such as computer control. Reflexion introduced verbal reinforcement learning, which turns failed trials into text that guides later attempts without updating model parameters. We introduce VRL-Bench, a harness for fair evaluation of trial-and-error learning under finite trial budgets. Across three models on MiniWoB and WebShop, we evaluate updates from several prominent verbal-memory methods spanning Reflexion and later work: each improves observed success over memory-free retry in some settings but reduces it in others. Replay experiments show that using reflection can reduce success rates, revealing a trade-off between exploiting experience and continued exploration. We propose VEX$^2$, a verbal exploration--exploitation scheduler that uses a language model to jointly select policies and allocate the remaining trial budget. VEX$^2$ is the only evaluated update to achieve positive observed success-rate gains over retry in all six settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VRL-Bench 用于在有限试错预算下公平评估语言智能体的试错学习，并发现现有言语记忆方法的增益不稳定；作者进一步提出 VEX$^2$ 调度器以平衡经验利用与探索，在全部六种设置中均取得正向增益。
AI.motivation: 现有言语强化学习（如 Reflexion）将失败试次转化为文本以指导后续尝试，无需更新模型参数，被视为提升语言智能体在计算机控制等复杂任务上的有效途径。然而，先前评估缺乏统一的有限试错预算设置，导致不同言语记忆方法的增益难以公平比较，且其有效性是否稳定尚不明确。
AI.method: 作者构建 VRL-Bench，一个在有限试错预算下公平评估试错学习的实验框架。在 MiniWoB 与 WebShop 上对三个模型进行评测，比较 Reflexion 及后续多种言语记忆方法的更新效果，并与无记忆重试基线对照。通过重放实验分析反思带来的影响。进而提出 VEX$^2$，一种言语探索–利用调度器，利用语言模型联合选择策略并分配剩余试错预算。
AI.result: 各言语记忆方法在部分设置中相较无记忆重试提升了观测成功率，但在另一些设置中反而降低。重放实验表明使用反思可能降低成功率，揭示出利用经验与持续探索之间的权衡。VEX$^2$ 是唯一在全部六种设置中均相较重试取得正向观测成功率增益的更新方法。
AI.conclusion: 有限预算下的试错学习增益依赖于经验利用与探索的平衡，现有言语记忆方法并不稳健。VEX$^2$ 通过语言模型驱动的策略选择与预算分配调度，能够稳定实现正向增益，为语言智能体的试错学习提供了更可靠的更新机制与评估基准。

title: Adaptive Chemotherapy Control under Tumor Heterogeneity via Reinforcement Learning
comment: 6 pages. Published in the 2026 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: Designing effective chemotherapy regimens is hindered by tumor heterogeneity and drug resistance, which complicate the deployment of patient-specific model-based optimal control across diverse populations. We develop and compare closed-loop deep reinforcement learning (DRL) dosing policies with continuous (TD3) and discrete (DQN) action spaces trained on a high-dimensional heterogeneous tumor model. The DRL policies are benchmarked against a Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (PMP)-derived open-loop benchmark. We assess generalization under parametric heterogeneity using a 100-patient virtual cohort with plus or minus 10 percent uniform perturbations in growth and drug-sensitivity parameters. Across this cohort, TD3 achieves higher average tumor reduction, while DQN yields tighter inter-patient dosing consistency, revealing a clear efficacy-consistency trade-off in this study. Our simulations assume full observation of all tumor subpopulations; translation to sparse and noisy clinical measurements will require partial-observability formulations and/or state estimation. Overall, the results show that simulation-trained DRL can learn state-dependent feedback dosing policies that complement open-loop optimal control benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了基于高维异质性肿瘤模型训练的闭环深度强化学习（DRL）给药策略（连续动作TD3与离散动作DQN）与PMP开环最优控制基准，并在100例虚拟患者队列上评估泛化性，揭示疗效与一致性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 肿瘤异质性与耐药性阻碍了患者特异性模型最优控制在多样化人群中的应用，亟需能适应状态变化、泛化性强的闭环给药策略。
AI.method: 构建高维异质性肿瘤模型，训练连续动作空间（TD3）与离散动作空间（DQN）的闭环DRL给药策略，并与基于庞特里亚金极大值原理（PMP）的开环最优控制基准进行对比；在含生长与药物敏感性参数±10%均匀扰动的100例虚拟患者队列上评估参数异质性下的泛化性能。
AI.result: 在整个虚拟队列中，TD3实现更高的平均肿瘤削减率，DQN则表现出更紧的患者间给药一致性，揭示了疗效与一致性之间的明显权衡。仿真假设所有肿瘤亚群完全可观测。
AI.conclusion: 仿真训练的DRL能够学习状态依赖的反馈给药策略，可作为开环最优控制基准的补充；但向稀疏、带噪临床测量的转化需要部分可观测建模和/或状态估计。

title: LifeMem: Enabling Lifelong Experience Reuse for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents are expected to continuously adapt to new tasks and environments over their lifetime by reusing past experience. However, existing memory-based agents struggle to transfer reusable experience across environments and suffer from catastrophic forgetting as experience accumulated. To address these challenges, we propose LifeMem, a lifelong learning framework that enables agents to transfer knowledge across multiple environments. During learning, LifeMem clusters accumulated interaction trajectories based on underlying workflows to extract reusable skills. When solving a new task at inference time, the agent recalls relevant skills and trajectories to guide actions. To validate our method, we conduct experiments across 10 environments and over 13k tasks with 2k newly annotated interaction trajectories. Results show that LifeMem enables effective experience reuse in lifelong learning, achieving both reduced forgetting on learned tasks and superior cross-task transfer. Further analysis reveals that task streaming impacts learning, while consolidating structurally similar trajectories within memory boosts performance.

AI.tldr: 提出LifeMem，一个通过聚类交互轨迹提取可复用技能来实现跨环境知识迁移的终身学习框架，在10个环境、13k+任务上验证了其减少遗忘与促进迁移的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于记忆的LLM智能体难以将可复用经验跨环境迁移，且随经验积累会出现灾难性遗忘，因此需要一种支持跨环境终身学习的机制。
AI.method: LifeMem在训练阶段基于底层工作流对累积的交互轨迹进行聚类，从中提取可复用的技能；在推理阶段，智能体回忆相关技能与轨迹来引导动作生成。
AI.result: 在10个环境、超过13k个任务、并额外标注2k条交互轨迹上进行实验，LifeMem实现了有效的经验复用，既降低了已学任务上的遗忘，又取得了更优的跨任务迁移。
AI.conclusion: LifeMem验证了终身学习中经验复用的可行性；分析表明任务流式输入顺序会影响学习效果，而在记忆中整合结构相似的轨迹可提升性能。

relevance.reason: 提出LLM智能体的终身学习记忆框架，复用交互轨迹提取技能并跨任务迁移，与LLM智能体优化控制相关。

title: LifeFuse-Mem: Lifecycle-Aware State Fusion Against Temporary Overwriting for Long-Term Memory
summary: Long-running LLM agents require memory mechanisms that maintain coherent internal states across interactions. We study a lifecycle-labeled memory setting in which write episodes provide lifecycle metadata during training, and phase-aware readout is used during evaluation. This setting reflects the need to distinguish information that should remain influential across future interactions from information that should affect only the current context. A mismatch between these lifecycles can cause temporary information to overwrite durable knowledge, leading to behavioral drift in persistent agents. Within this setting, we introduce \textbf{LifeFuse-Mem}, a lifecycle-aware neural memory framework that separates information according to its temporal commitment. LifeFuse-Mem uses dedicated memory components and lifecycle-aware updates to allow stable and transient knowledge to evolve locally without converting temporary context into durable state. On the controlled anti-overwrite benchmark, LifeFuse-Mem improves acquisition-controlled retention and reduces temporary overwrite; on two public long-memory benchmarks, it remains broadly competitive. These results suggest that explicit lifecycle signals can help diagnose and mitigate overwrite in compact online memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出生命周期感知的记忆框架 LifeFuse-Mem，通过区分稳定知识与临时上下文，缓解长期 LLM 智能体中的记忆覆盖与行为漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的 LLM 智能体需要跨交互维持连贯的内部状态。现有记忆机制难以区分应长期影响未来交互的信息与仅影响当前上下文的临时信息，二者的生命周期错配会导致临时信息覆盖持久知识，引发持久智能体的行为漂移。
AI.method: 研究设定为生命周期标注记忆：训练时写入片段提供生命周期元数据，评估时采用相位感知读出。在此设定下提出 LifeFuse-Mem，一种生命周期感知的神经记忆框架，依据信息的时间承诺进行分离，使用专用记忆组件与生命周期感知更新，使稳定知识与瞬态知识在本地各自演化，避免临时上下文转化为持久状态。
AI.result: 在受控的反覆盖基准上，LifeFuse-Mem 提升了受采集控制的信息保持能力，并减少了临时性覆盖；在两个公开长记忆基准上，其表现整体具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，显式的生命周期信号有助于诊断并缓解紧凑型在线记忆中的覆盖问题。

relevance.reason: 面向长期LLM智能体的生命周期感知记忆机制，涉及智能体状态维持，与LLM智能体研究相关，但未涉及优化算法设计。

title: From Collaboration to Capability: Internalizing Routed LLM Experts into Compact Reasoners
summary: A compact controller can coordinate stronger experts by selecting whom to consult, formulating requests, and integrating their responses. We study whether learning from both the controller's decisions and the experts' reasoning and code improves its generation after expert removal. We introduce \textsc{Rivet} for \emph{collaboration internalization}: expert-augmented reinforcement learning applies a shared outcome signal to controller decisions and returned expert spans, and verified trajectory internalization consolidates complete successful interactions through format-aware supervised training. The deployed controller generates reasoning, code, and interaction structure with local Python execution and no external LLM. Across seven competition-mathematics benchmarks, RIVET-1.7B and RIVET-4B achieve average accuracies of $28.25\%$ and $44.16\%$; Stage~II improves RIVET-4B's accuracy after expert removal by $6.49$ points, and GPQA-Diamond results provide evidence of generalization to scientific reasoning. Ablations show gains from ordinary trajectory supervision and additional format weighting, supporting the effectiveness of training on the content and structure of verified collaborations.

AI.tldr: 提出RIVET，通过专家增强强化学习与验证轨迹内化，将多专家协作能力蒸馏进紧凑控制器，使其在无外部LLM条件下独立完成推理与代码生成。
AI.motivation: 紧凑控制器可协调更强专家，但研究者关心在移除专家后，能否通过学习控制器决策以及专家的推理与代码来提升其自身生成能力。
AI.method: RIVET（协作内化）包含两部分：(1) 专家增强强化学习，将共享结果信号同时施加于控制器决策与返回的专家片段；(2) 验证轨迹内化，通过格式感知的监督训练整合完整成功交互。部署后的控制器基于本地Python执行生成推理、代码与交互结构，无需外部LLM。
AI.result: 在七个竞赛数学基准上，RIVET-1.7B与RIVET-4B平均准确率分别为28.25%与44.16%；Stage II使RIVET-4B在移除专家后的准确率提升6.49个百分点；GPQA-Diamond结果证明对科学推理的泛化能力。消融实验显示普通轨迹监督与额外格式加权均带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 对已验证协作的内容与结构进行训练是有效的，支持通过内化协作过程提升紧凑模型在专家移除后的独立生成能力。

relevance.reason: 将多专家路由协作通过强化学习与监督训练内化到紧凑LLM推理模型中，属于LLM+RL的算法与训练方法研究，与LLM优化及自动推理能力增强相关。

title: Beyond Generation and Accuracy: Diagnosing and Enhancing Visual Chain-of-Thought for Geometry Problem Solving
summary: While multimodal reasoning has advanced rapidly, solving complex geometry problems critically hinges on active visual assistance, such as constructing auxiliary lines, spurring the rise of Visual Chain-of-Thought (VCoT). However, existing evaluations typically assess visual generation quality and final answer accuracy in isolation, failing to examine whether intermediate visual aids are geometrically valid, effectively utilized in subsequent reasoning, or causally responsible for task success. To bridge this gap, we introduce GeoVAD-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark that pairs a fine-grained five-dimensional trajectory diagnosis covering perception, auxiliary quality, utilization, deductive reasoning, and final correctness with controlled No-Aux, Auto-Aux, and GT-Aux intervention settings to systematically isolate intermediate error modes, the causal gains of visual aids, and the resulting autonomy gap. Our findings reveal that while high-quality auxiliary aids offer substantial theoretical gains for geometric problem solving, autonomous generation is frequently hampered by compounding errors across geometric perception, faithful visual manipulation, visual-state grounding, and deductive reasoning. Guided by these diagnostic insights, we establish a specialized data construction pipeline encompassing geometric perception, diagram editing, and interleaved visual-textual reasoning trajectories, and develop a progressive SFT and multimodal RL training framework. The resulting model, GeoWeave-8B, outperforms the base model by +25.3% in final geometric accuracy and achieves a +30.4% gain in process average across the four intermediate diagnostic dimensions.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoVAD-Bench诊断基准与GeoWeave-8B模型，揭示几何VCoT中间环节的复合误差并显著提升几何推理准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态几何推理评估仅孤立衡量视觉生成质量与最终答案正确性，无法判断中间视觉辅助是否几何有效、是否被后续推理真正利用、是否与任务成功存在因果联系，缺乏对中间错误模式的诊断能力。
AI.method: 构建GeoVAD-Bench：包含感知、辅助质量、利用、演绎推理、最终正确性五个维度的细粒度轨迹诊断，并设置No-Aux、Auto-Aux、GT-Aux三种干预以分离中间错误模式、视觉辅助的因果增益与自主性差距。基于诊断结论，建立涵盖几何感知、图形编辑、图文交错推理轨迹的数据构建管线，并设计渐进式SFT与多模态RL训练框架，得到GeoWeave-8B。
AI.result: 高质量辅助在理论上对几何解题带来显著增益，但自主生成常因几何感知、忠实视觉操作、视觉状态grounding与演绎推理环节的复合误差而受限；GeoWeave-8B较基座模型最终几何准确率提升+25.3%，四个中间诊断维度的过程平均提升+30.4%。
AI.conclusion: 诊断驱动的基准与干预设计能有效定位几何VCoT的中间瓶颈，配套的数据与渐进式SFT+多模态RL训练可显著缩小自主性差距并提升过程与结果表现。

title: Skill Issue: Lessons from Optimizing Repository SKILLs for Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents increasingly read repository knowledge from SKILLs --- plain \texttt{.md} files versioned alongside the code. Recent work synthesizes these files automatically, by optimizing the document against a benchmark. A bare repository comes with no benchmark, and the synthetic tasks prior work builds are small enough that a capable agent saturates them with no document at all. We mine harder tasks --- merged pull requests of the repository, reverted at a single frozen base commit; and score a candidate document by whether the same agent does better with it than without it. On three Kotlin repositories, the documents GEPA finds raise this score by $4.9$pp on average, and the ones SkillOpt finds leave it where it started, $0.1$pp above the seed. The GEPA gain matches what prior work reports with the same optimizer, and at the dataset size a single repository supplies it cannot be separated from the agent's run-to-run variance; settling that would take more tasks than one repository's history yields. The documents themselves read better than the score: a maintainer of one repository found in them knowledge one only gets by working in the project.

AI.tldr: 本文针对代码智能体从SKILL文档（随代码版本管理的.md文件）获取仓库知识这一场景，提出以仓库已合并又被回滚的pull request构造更难任务，并以"同一智能体在有文档时是否比无文档表现更好"作为文档评分标准，在三个Kotlin仓库上比较了GEPA与SkillOpt两种优化方法。
AI.motivation: 已有工作通常依赖基准来优化自动合成的SKILL文档，但裸仓库并不自带基准；而既有工作构造的合成任务规模太小，能力较强的智能体即使没有文档也能将其饱和解决，导致评分缺乏区分度。因此需要更难的、由真实仓库历史衍生的任务来评估文档的实际价值。
AI.method: 任务构造：挖掘仓库中已合并但在某个冻结基线上被回滚的pull request，形成更难的任务集。评分方式：以"同一智能体在有候选文档时相对无文档时的表现提升"作为文档得分，即在无基准依赖的条件下做相对增益评估。优化对比：使用GEPA与SkillOpt两种方法在三个Kotlin仓库上自动优化候选文档。
AI.result: 在三个Kotlin仓库上，GEPA生成的文档使该评分平均提升4.9个百分点；SkillOpt生成的文档几乎无提升，仅比种子高0.1个百分点。GEPA的提升幅度与既有工作在相同优化器下报告的数值相当，但在单个仓库所能提供的数据集规模下，该增益难以与智能体逐次运行的方差区分开，若要判定需超过单个仓库历史所能提供的任务数量。文档质量的主观可读性优于其分数表现：某仓库的维护者从中发现了只有实际参与该项目工作才能获得的知识。
AI.conclusion: 以被回滚的已合并pull request构造任务、并以"有文档相对无文档"的提升作为评分，是无需人工基准即可评估SKILL文档价值的可行路径；GEPA相对SkillOpt在该设定下明显更有效，但其增益在当前数据规模下尚与运行方差混杂，需要通过跨仓库汇总更多任务来验证统计显著性。同时，文档的实用价值可能高于自动评分的表现。

relevance.reason: 优化代码库SKILL文档以提升LLM编码代理性能，属于LLM代理与优化交叉，但非核心组合优化/进化算法焦点。

title: What Drives Recovery in Agentic Text-to-Cypher? LAST-CQ: An LLM Agent Self-Refinement Framework
comment: Accepted at REALM: The 2nd Workshop for Research on Agent Language Models at Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), 15 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables
summary: Agentic pipelines for structured-query generation are rapidly expanding, but it is unclear which part of the loop produces the gain. We use LAST-CQ -- a five-agent, training-free, execution-grounded Text-to-Cypher framework -- as an instrumented testbed, running three counterfactuals over 2,471 live-database queries and six backbones spanning three vendor scale tiers. Removing correction is worth between 3.1% aggregate execution-BLEU against the single-pass system and 12.3% against a no-refinement counterfactual (up to 80.7% for the weakest backbone). Replacing schema-grounded, LLM-synthesised feedback with raw database error strings costs almost nothing (20.9% vs. 19.9% naive exact match; <0.2% end-to-end; equivalent within $\pm 0.075$ set-F1 by two one-sided tests). Spending the same call budget on parallel sampling degrades quality by 10-11%. What works is detecting failure and routing it to a retry, not the feedback sophistication or number of samples. LAST-CQ itself recovers 91.7% of queries that fail under single-pass generation, while a query that succeeds first time still costs exactly one LLM call. We also show that n-gram overlap on serialised results is not a bound in either direction: it over-scores against set equivalence on 65.9% of results while under-scoring against judged semantics. Finally, we calibrate our LLM judge against blind human labels and find it optimistic by 9 points.

AI.tldr: 该论文以 LAST-CQ（五智能体、免训练、执行落地的 Text-to-Cypher 框架）为可插拔测试床，通过三个反事实实验定位智能体流水线中真正带来收益的环节。
AI.motivation: 智能体式结构化查询生成流水线快速扩张，但尚不清楚这一循环中究竟哪一部分（纠错环节、反馈的精细程度，还是采样数量）真正贡献了性能增益，缺乏受控的归因证据。
AI.method: 在 2,471 条实时数据库查询、六种骨干模型（覆盖三个厂商规模层级）上运行三个反事实：(1) 移除纠错环节；(2) 用原始数据库错误字符串替换基于 schema、由 LLM 合成的反馈；(3) 将同等调用预算用于并行采样。同时用 n-gram 重叠（执行-BLEU）与集合等价、人工判定语义做对比校验，并将 LLM 评判器与盲标人类标注进行校准。
AI.result: 移除纠错带来 3.1%（相对单遍系统）至 12.3%（相对无精炼反事实）的执行-BLEU 损失，最弱骨干上高达 80.7%；用原始错误字符串替换 LLM 合成反馈几乎无损（20.9% vs 19.9% naive exact match，端到端 <0.2%，两次单侧检验下 ±0.075 set-F1 内等价）；同等预算用于并行采样反而使质量下降 10–11%。LAST-CQ 自身可恢复单遍生成下 91.7% 的失败查询，且首次成功的查询仍只消耗一次 LLM 调用。n-gram 重叠既非上界也非下界：在 65.9% 的结果上相对集合等价高估，而相对人工判定语义则低估。LLM 评判器经盲标校准后显示乐观约 9 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 有效的是"检测失败并将其路由到重试"这一机制，而非反馈的精细程度或采样数量；执行落地的重试路由是智能体流水线增益的关键来源，同时常用的 n-gram 与 LLM 评判指标存在系统性偏差，需谨慎解读。

title: Autonomous Research for Open-Ended Problems: A Case Study on Telecom Ticket Retrieval
summary: Recent breakthroughs in LLM-based systems and their abilities in problem solving and coding have allowed progress in the AI for Science paradigm, potentially replacing human roles in machine learning (ML) research. However, while several frameworks of fully autonomous end-to-end ML research have been proposed, successful implementations of them are often limited to problems with narrow search spaces, like language modeling or biomedical ML benchmarks. In this paper, we explore how autonomous research can be adapted to solve open-ended, industry-grade ML problems, by considering a case study: telecom ticket retrieval, an open-ended task with degrees of freedom in representation, architecture, and training data generation. We discover that autonomous research for open-ended problems with commercial and open-source agents shows both promise and limitations: while autonomous research can excel in narrow hyperparameter optimization, it lacks human-like intuition and creativity and requires operational overhead. Even with minimal human supervision, autonomous research can reach $90\%$ of state-of-the-art performance (0.34 vs. 0.38 Recall@1) in a much shorter time period (10 weeks vs. 10 months of human work) at a modest cost (up to \$200 per Cursor campaign). Our empirical evidence recommends that human researchers and autonomous research frameworks work together for best results in ML research.

title: Offline Reinforcement Learning for Wind Farm Control: A Wind Tunnel Study under Dynamic Wind Directions
summary: This paper addresses the wind farm power maximization problem in the presence of wind direction changes. Specifically, a model-free Modified Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient with Behavior Cloning (MTD3-BC) algorithm is proposed to tackle this task through yaw control under varying wind direction conditions. MTD3-BC is an offline reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm that aims to infer good behavior from only a precollected offline dataset. Additionally, to ensure smooth and moderate yaw adjustments, a new action consistency term is introduced into the policy optimization objective. Unlike online RL methods, MTD3-BC does not require extensive interactions with a wind farm simulator during training, significantly reducing computational costs and training time. A wind tunnel experiment is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the algorithm under varying wind directions. The results demonstrate that MTD3-BC successfully mitigates wake effects, delivering farm-level power gains of approximately 10\% over the baseline greedy strategy and performance on par with a data-calibrated model-based wake-steering benchmark, while requiring no wake model and only a small fraction of the training cost of online RL. To our knowledge, this is the first time an offline RL wind farm control policy has been validated and demonstrated experimentally.

AI.tldr: 提出离线强化学习算法MTD3-BC用于风向变化下的风电场偏航控制功率最大化，并通过风洞实验首次验证离线RL风电场控制策略。
AI.motivation: 风电场功率最大化在风向变化条件下具有挑战性；在线强化学习方法需大量与仿真器交互，计算成本与训练时间高，且缺乏基于离线数据的控制策略实验验证。
AI.method: 提出无模型的MTD3-BC算法，结合行为克隆从预采集离线数据集中学习策略；在策略优化目标中引入动作一致性项以实现平滑适度的偏航调整；训练过程无需大规模与风电场仿真器交互。
AI.result: 风洞实验表明，MTD3-BC有效缓解尾流效应，相较贪婪基线策略实现约10%的场级功率增益，性能与基于数据校准的模型驱动尾流转向基准相当，且无需尾流模型，训练成本仅为在线RL的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: MTD3-BC为风向变化下的风电场偏航控制提供了高效离线RL方案；这是首次对离线RL风电场控制策略进行实验验证与演示。

title: MCRL2: Multi-resource Cross-attention-based Representation Learning-augmented Reinforcement Learning for Cloud Microservice Scheduling
summary: Efficient microservice scheduling is crucial for maintaining load balance across nodes in data centers and ensuring high quality of service. However, achieving this in practice remains challenging due to dynamic resource imbalance under fluctuating workloads, nonlinear coupling across multiple resource dimensions, and the heterogeneity of microservice resource demands. While reinforcement learning-based approaches have shown promise, they struggle to capture the complex interdependencies among heterogeneous resources and neglect the importance of learning informative system representations. To address these limitations, we propose MCRL2, a novel reinforcement learning approach augmented with multi-resource cross-attention-based representation learning for microservice scheduling. Specifically, we first propose MCRL, a novel representation learning approach that captures structured and informative interactions among nodes, resources, and microservices via a multi-resource cross-attention mechanism. Then, MCRL2 augments reinforcement learning through MCRL-enhanced actor-critic architecture combined with a maximum entropy objective, improving system state expressiveness and leading to more stable and effective scheduling decisions. Extensive experiments on real production cluster traces demonstrate that MCRL2 significantly outperforms existing baselines in load balancing, scheduling success rate and average completion time across diverse workload patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MCRL2，一种结合多资源交叉注意力表示学习的强化学习方法，用于微服务调度，以解决动态负载下资源不均衡、多维资源非线性耦合和异构需求问题。
AI.motivation: 数据中心微服务调度需维持节点负载均衡并保障服务质量，但实际中面临波动负载下的动态资源不均衡、多资源维度的非线性耦合以及微服务资源需求异构等挑战。现有强化学习方法难以捕捉异构资源间复杂依赖关系，且忽视学习有信息量的系统表示。
AI.method: 先提出MCRL表示学习方法，通过多资源交叉注意力机制捕捉节点、资源与微服务之间结构化且有信息量的交互；再将MCRL增强的actor-critic架构与最大熵目标结合，增广强化学习，提升系统状态表达能力。
AI.result: 在真实生产集群轨迹上的大量实验表明，MCRL2在多种负载模式下于负载均衡、调度成功率和平均完成时间方面显著优于现有基线。
AI.conclusion: MCRL2通过多资源交叉注意力表示学习增强强化学习，改善了系统状态表达，能产生更稳定有效的调度决策，在真实生产环境中表现优越。

title: Performance, Efficiency and Collapse -- Advantages and Challenges in Offline Post-training of Code LLMs
summary: Post-training with reinforcement learning (RL) is a critical phase in the development of code-generating large language models (LLMs), as it ensures adherence to instructions and the production of functionally correct code. This process typically requires computationally intensive code sample generation from Transformer-based LLMs and substantial GPU-CPU communication for sequence verification. To address these computational challenges, this work examines whether RL-based post-training can be performed entirely offline by leveraging existing datasets rather than generating new samples. The findings indicate that, with only a few hours of training, zero-shot code generation performance of LLMs can be substantially improved without online sampling. Additionally, offline RL produces performance gains across models ranging from 0.5B to 7B parameters, although the extent of improvement varies among model families.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨以离线强化学习替代在线采样进行代码生成大模型的后训练，在无需在线生成样本的情况下，用数小时训练即可显著提升零样本代码生成性能。
AI.motivation: 在线强化学习后训练依赖Transformer大模型进行高算力的代码样本生成，并伴随大量GPU-CPU通信用于序列验证，计算开销巨大。作者希望验证能否完全离线地利用现有数据集完成RL后训练，以规避这些计算瓶颈。
AI.method: 采用离线强化学习范式，直接利用已有数据集而非在线生成新样本，对代码生成大模型进行后训练，并在0.5B至7B参数规模的多个模型家族上进行验证。
AI.result: 仅需数小时训练，无需在线采样即可大幅提升大模型的零样本代码生成性能；离线RL在0.5B至7B参数范围的模型上均带来性能增益，但不同模型家族的提升幅度存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 离线强化学习可作为代码生成大模型后训练的可行且高效的替代方案，在显著降低计算与通信开销的同时实现性能提升。

title: MAAPO:an innovative membrane algorithm based on artificial protozoa optimizer for multilevel threshold image segmentation
summary: This paper proposes a novel membrane algorithm based on artificial protozoa optimizer (MAAPO) for global optimization problems. The artificial protozoa optimizer (APO) is adopted as the base meta-heuristic algorithm due to its novelty and competitive performance. MAAPO integrates two key innovations:(1) a membrane computing (MC) framework that introduces a parallel distributed paradigm to improve population diversity and search dynamics, and (2) an enhanced autotrophic model within APO that uses a roulette-based fitness-distance balance (RFDB) mechanism for adaptive reference point selection. These strategies collectively enhance the algorithm's exploration-exploitation balance and global search capabilities. To validate its performance, MAAPO is tested against 12 advanced algorithms on the CEC2017 test suite, and further applied to the multilevel thresholding image segmentation problem using Otsu and Kapur entropy as objective functions. The quality of segmented images is assessed using peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity index (SSIM), and feature similarity index (FSIM) metrics. Experimental results demonstrate that MAAPO outperforms its counterparts, delivering superior segmentation quality. This research on MAAPO contributes an effective enhancement strategy to meta-heuristic algorithms and introduces a novel, highly applicable approach for complex image segmentation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于人工原生动物优化器（APO）的膜算法MAAPO，用于全局优化，并应用于多阈值图像分割。

AI.conclusion: MAAPO为元启发式算法提供了有效增强策略，并为复杂图像分割提供了新的高适用性方法。

title: Language Is an Insufficient Substrate for Quantitative Reasoning, and Consequential Domains Need Large Quantitative Models
summary: The prevailing assumption in applied machine learning is that progress on consequential quantitative decisions such as pricing risk, allocating capital, triaging patients, or containing a network intrusion will follow from progress in large language models (LLMs). A language model is trained on a representation of the world that was produced by human description; description is a lossy encoding of the quantitative record, and the loss is irreversible: no downstream model, at any scale, can recover from a description what the description did not encode. We formalize this as a property of the representation on which a model is trained rather than of the model capacity, and we identify three further properties that consequential settings demand of a model and that a language substrate cannot supply by construction: reproducibility, lineage from every output back to the source records that produced. it, and calibrated uncertainty. We argue that these properties define a distinct model class, which we call the Large Quantitative Model (LQM).

AI.tldr: 本文提出"大型定量模型"(LQM)这一新模型类别，论证以语言描述为训练基底无法胜任高风险定量决策：描述是定量记录的有损编码且损失不可逆，与模型规模无关。作者指明这类场景还要求可复现性、输出到源记录的血缘追溯、以及校准的不确定性，这三项属性是语言基底结构上无法提供的。
AI.motivation: 应用机器学习领域普遍假设，定价风险、资本配置、患者分诊、网络入侵遏制等关键定量决策的进步将随大语言模型(LLM)的发展而自然实现。作者质疑这一前提，认为进步的瓶颈不在模型能力，而在训练所依赖的表示本身。
AI.method: 以理论论证为主，不涉及实验。核心手段是将问题形式化为训练表示的性质，而非模型容量的性质：(1) 语言模型训练于由人类描述生成的世界表示，而描述是定量记录的有损编码，且该损失不可逆——任何下游模型在任何规模下都无法从描述中恢复其未编码的信息；(2) 进一步识别出关键场景对模型的三项结构性要求：可复现性、从每个输出回溯到产生它的源记录的血缘关系、校准的不确定性，并论证语言基底无法在构造上满足这些要求。
AI.result: 论证得到两个结论性判断：定量记录的信息损失是表示层面的、不可逆的，无法通过扩大模型规模弥补；可复现性、血缘追溯与校准不确定性是语言基底在构造上无法提供的属性。据此，作者认为这些属性共同定义了一个独立的模型类别，即大型定量模型(LQM)。
AI.conclusion: 关键定量决策的进展不应寄望于LLM的自然外溢，而需要一类以定量记录而非语言描述为基底的独立模型类别(LQM)。该类别以可复现性、源记录血缘和校准不确定性为核心约束，其可行性取决于表示层面而非模型规模。

relevance.reason: 论证LLM在定量推理上的局限性并提出新的LQM模型类别，与LLM用于优化和决策的核心问题相关。

title: SCQ: Stabilizing Conservative Q-Learning with Sigmoid-Bounded Entropy
summary: Offline-to-online reinforcement learning reduces interaction cost for real-world robot learning but suffers from persistent value estimation instability. Existing methods address this through pessimistic regularization, lower-bound calibration, and architectural normalization, but an overlooked source of instability lies in the entropy formulation: the standard log-entropy term can become negative, destabilizing policy updates. We introduce SCQ (Sigmoid-Bounded Conservative Q-Learning), which replaces this term with a sigmoid-bounded formulation that stays strictly positive. SCQ retains conservative Q regularization and return-based lower-bound calibration, stabilizing policy optimization without sacrificing exploration. We evaluate SCQ on D4RL (Minari) benchmarks under both single-demonstration and standard dataset settings, as well as on simulation and real-world visual tasks. SCQ matches or exceeds baseline performance while exhibiting more stable training dynamics across state-based and visual benchmarks, and transfers to four real-robot platforms including manipulation, wheeled, quadruped, and humanoid systems. A direct clipping intervention that removes negative log-probability contributions, together with gradient-matched positive-score controls, indicates that positivity rather than a particular score shape alone drives much of the improvement. Project website: https://scq-rl.github.io.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SCQ方法，通过将有符号的log-entropy替换为sigmoid有界且严格为正的熵形式，缓解离线到在线强化学习中的值估计与策略更新不稳定问题，在D4RL及真实机器人平台上验证了稳定性与性能。
AI.motivation: 离线到在线强化学习虽能降低真实机器人交互成本，但存在持续的值估计不稳定问题。现有方法主要通过悲观正则、下界校准与架构归一化来解决，而作者指出被忽视的不稳定来源在于熵公式本身：标准log-entropy项可能取负值，从而破坏策略更新的稳定性。
AI.method: 提出SCQ（Sigmoid-Bounded Conservative Q-Learning）：用sigmoid有界、严格为正的熵公式替换标准log-entropy项；同时保留保守Q正则与基于回报的下界校准，在稳定策略优化的同时不牺牲探索。
AI.result: 在D4RL（Minari）基准上，涵盖单演示与标准数据集设置，并在仿真与真实视觉任务中评估。SCQ性能匹配或超越基线，且在基于状态与视觉的基准上训练动态更稳定，并迁移到四类真实机器人平台（操作、轮式、四足、人形）。直接裁剪干预（移除负log概率贡献）与梯度匹配的正分数对照实验表明，熵项的正性而非特定分数形状本身，是大部分性能提升的驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: SCQ表明熵公式的负值是离线到在线强化学习中一个被忽视的不稳定来源，采用sigmoid有界正熵可稳定策略优化并保持性能与探索，且具备跨状态、视觉与真实机器人平台的泛化与迁移能力。

title: Groupoid-Based Internal State Representations for Reinforcement Learning with Local Symmetries
comment: The Eighteenth Workshop on Adaptive and Learning Agents(ALA 2026). AAMAS 2026
summary: Symmetries play a central role in reducing the complexity of reinforcement learning problems, yet most existing approaches rely on fixed group actions or predefined state abstractions. Classical reinforcement learning algorithms typically assume a globally structured Markov decision process with uniformly applicable actions and transitions, an assumption that limits their ability to exploit modularity and local, context-dependent regularities present in many realistic environments. We propose a reinforcement learning framework using groupoids to capture local, state-dependent symmetries and support the dy- namic discovery of equivalence structures during interaction. The agent maintains orbit representatives together with transporters that map raw states to canonical forms, enabling learning and decision-making to be performed in a symmetry-reduced space while preserving local distinctions. Empirical results demonstrate that the proposed groupoid-based approach improves sample efficiency and convergence in dense and large-scale environments exhibiting strong partial symmetries, yielding substantial performance gains over standard Q-learning. These findings show that dynamically exploiting local symmetry provides a practical and mathematically principled route to scalable and generalisable reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用群胚（groupoid）刻画状态依赖的局部对称性，并在交互中动态发现等价结构，从而在对称约简空间中学习，提升强化学习的样本效率与收敛性。
AI.motivation: 经典强化学习通常假设全局结构化的马尔可夫决策过程，动作与转移全局统一适用，这一假设限制了其利用现实环境中普遍存在的模块化与局部、上下文相关的规律性。现有对称性方法多依赖固定群作用或预定义状态抽象，缺乏动态适应性。
AI.method: 提出基于群胚的强化学习框架，用以捕捉局部、状态依赖的对称性，并支持在交互过程中动态发现等价结构。智能体维护轨道代表元（orbit representatives）与传输映射（transporters），后者将原始状态映射到规范形式，使学习与决策可在保持局部区分性的对称约简空间中进行。

AI.conclusion: 动态利用局部对称性为可扩展、可泛化的强化学习提供了一条实用且具有数学原理支撑的途径。

title: Reinforcement Learning over Patient Trajectories for Clinical Reasoning in EHR Foundation Models
summary: Electronic health record (EHR) foundation models trained on longitudinal patient trajectories have demonstrated strong performance across diverse clinical prediction tasks. However, their clinical reasoning capabilities remain constrained by next-token prediction on limited and incomplete EHR data. To address this, we propose a reinforcement learning (RL) fine-tuning framework that treats EHR foundation models as generative policies over patient trajectories. We formulate common clinical prediction problems (e.g., hospital readmission) as event-conditioned, time-windowed reasoning tasks. We then design time-aware, rollout-sensitive rewards to account for finite rollout lengths and temporally inconclusive outcomes. We find that RL fine-tuning consistently improves over pre-trained backbones and strong baselines. Notably, it enables smaller models to surpass larger pre-trained models in data-limited regimes and induces positive transfer across tasks. Further analysis shows that RL fine-tuned models generate trajectories with stronger structural and semantic alignment to ground truth and greater downstream utility.

title: GAUGE: When Not to Trust LLM-as-a-Judge in User-Simulated Evaluation of Task-Oriented Agents
summary: Comparing and selecting task-oriented LLM agents increasingly relies on a low-cost offline evaluation gate: persona-driven LLM user-simulators converse with each candidate, an LLM-as-a-judge scores the transcripts, and the higher-scoring agent is promoted. We introduce GAUGE, a reusable offline protocol that measures whether this gate's ranking matches a grounded verifiable reward across 25 agents from six providers on the $τ^2$-bench and SimulatorArena benchmarks, separating two kinds of evaluation validity that release practices conflate: ranking validity and construct validity. First, a satisfaction-success gap: satisfaction carries essentially no information about task success, as conversations rated satisfied by our blind panel are decorrelated from actual success, with 57.5% of them failing the customer's task, a pattern consistent across five rater populations, both benchmarks, and every subjective dimension we rated. Second, while the gate's ranking is robust across the broad capability span, it loses resolution among the near-equal strong agents: this decision-disagreement rate jumps from $<$1% on wide-reward pairs to 31% on close pairs. The gate is thus human-validated yet mis-anchored. As a remedy, we propose a calibrate-then-trust cadence in which a judge-free completion bit is a zero-cost tripwire for truncation regressions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAUGE协议，检验基于LLM用户模拟器与LLM评判的离线评估门控是否能复现可验证奖励的排序，发现满意度与任务成功脱钩，且门控在强代理间分辨率不足。
AI.motivation: 任务型LLM代理的比较与筛选日益依赖低成本离线评估门控：由人设驱动的LLM用户模拟器与候选代理对话，再由LLM作为评判打分，高分者被选中。然而该门控的有效性缺乏与可验证奖励的对齐检验，且现有发布实践混淆了排序效度与构念效度两类评估效度。
AI.method: 提出可复用的离线协议GAUGE，在τ²-bench与SimulatorArena两个基准上，对来自六家提供商的25个代理，比较门控排名与有据可查的可验证奖励排名，并区分排序效度与构念效度；同时通过盲评小组与五类评分者群体评估满意度与任务成功的关系。
AI.result: 存在满意度—成功鸿沟：满意度几乎不携带任务成功信息，盲评小组判定为满意的对话与实际成功去相关，其中57.5%未完成客户任务，且该模式在五类评分者群体、两个基准及所有主观维度上一致。门控排名在能力跨度大时稳健，但在实力相近的强代理间失去分辨率，决策分歧率从宽奖励配对的<1%升至接近配对的31%。

title: HypoKG: Evidence-Disciplined Biomedical Hypothesis Generation Beyond Endpoint Knowledge
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate biomedical hypotheses, but it remains unclear whether they truly reason from scientific evidence or simply produce convincing-sounding ideas. To study this, we combine three major biological databases: the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), Rhea, and UniProt, into a unified biochemical knowledge graph and construct a benchmark of 550 paths connecting enzyme sources to rare disease endpoints, yielding 13,200 hypotheses from six LLMs under four conditions varying the biological information each model receives: source enzyme only, full biological path, or source and disease endpoint only. Hypotheses are scored using an expert-derived five-criterion rubric on a 1-5 scale per criterion. We find that models given both the source and disease endpoint often produce the highest-scoring hypotheses, showing that LLMs can generate compelling ideas from minimal information. However, these hypotheses are less grounded in the evidence. In contrast, models given the full biological path generate hypotheses more consistent with known mechanistic relationships. We call this evidence-disciplined reasoning. To confirm this effect, we shuffled intermediate path steps while keeping endpoints fixed. Evidence grounding dropped significantly (delta = -0.793, p < 0.001), confirming models genuinely used path structure during reasoning. Our findings show that knowledge graphs support hypothesis generation in two ways: they identify biological endpoint pairs absent from the literature, and their mechanistic paths guide how LLMs reason between them.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了统一生化知识图谱与550条路径基准，用1-5分五准则评分体系评估六种LLM在四种信息条件下的13,200条假设，发现仅给源与疾病终点时假设得分最高但证据依托弱，给完整生物路径时假设与已知机制更一致（即"证据约束推理"），并通过打乱中间步骤验证模型确实使用了路径结构（delta=-0.793, p<0.001）。
AI.motivation: LLM可生成生物医学假设，但其究竟是真正基于科学证据推理，还是仅产出听起来可信的观点，尚不清楚。作者希望厘清LLM假设生成中"说服力"与"证据依托"之间的关系，并明确知识图谱在其中发挥的作用。
AI.method: 整合KEGG、Rhea、UniProt三大生物数据库为统一生化知识图谱；构建含550条连接酶来源与罕见病终点的路径基准；在四种条件下（仅源酶、完整生物路径、仅源+疾病终点等）由六种LLM生成13,200条假设；采用专家制定的五准则1-5分评分量表打分；并做中间路径步骤打乱、保持终点不变的对照实验。
AI.result: 同时获得源与疾病终点的模型常产生得分最高的假设，说明LLM能从极少信息生成有吸引力的想法，但这些假设的证据依托较弱；获得完整生物路径的模型生成的假设与已知机制关系更一致。打乱中间步骤后证据依托显著下降（delta=-0.793, p<0.001），证实模型在推理中确实使用了路径结构。
AI.conclusion: 知识图谱以两种方式支持假设生成：识别文献中缺失的生物终点对，以及通过其机制路径引导LLM在两端点之间进行推理。作者将完整路径条件下表现出的特性称为"证据约束推理"（evidence-disciplined reasoning），提示信息完整性对假设的证据可靠性至关重要。
